args.command:

- Standardize \"blocks per 4 GB\" to a single consistent value (currently 21,845 / 21,800 / 21,846 in different places)

args.description: Create third child bead for values and measurements

args.command:
bf create --title "Fix systematic problems and missing content in plan.md" --description "# Acceptance Criteria

- Add error codes to E1/E4/E16/E18 (currently have no error codes)

- Fix §8.2's example which is one character short

- Add Android Chrome row to §8.4 (it's named as the reference receiver in §13.2)
- Remove or correct the retracted \"QR is denser than libcimbar\" claim from spike-results.md

# Notes
This is the fourth child bead of the split from bf-4h5p. This addresses all remaining systematic issues: missing error codes, encoding inconsistencies, incomplete examples, ambiguous wording, missing table rows, and retracted claims." --label split-child
args.description: Create fourth child bead for systematic problems
